_doc: Canonical ScopeRefType members. Gateway (questionLibrary.ts) derives both `ALLOWED_SCOPE_REF_TYPES` and the `ScopeRefType` literal-string union from this file. The frontend (architectConversationApi.ts) keeps its own literal mirror of the same union for now; drift between the two TS declarations and this JSON file is enforced at test-time by `frontend/src/api/__tests__/scopeRefType.contractWithGateway.test.ts`. Update this file when adding or removing a scope type; both packages derive their constants from this single source of truth.
